CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_SDIACCOUNT_TRY
AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount AS (

SELECT
	BTS.Id AS SDIAccountId
	,BTS.Beneficiary_Id AS CustomerAccountId
	,BTS.CBCGLAcctSixDigits AS LastSixDigitsRelatedCustomerAccountId
	,BTS.Direct AS DirectIndicator
	,BTS.Roles AS RoleId
	,BTS.ProcessingOrg AS ProcessingOrgId
	,BTS.Currencies AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BTS.Pay_Receive AS PayReceiveId
	,BTS.Method AS MethodId
	,BTS.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BTS.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BTSD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.TRY_SDI_DELTA BTSD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRY_SDI BTS ON BTSD.ID = BTS.ID AND BTSD.Beneficiary_Id = BTS.Beneficiary_Id AND BTSD.ID = BTS.ID AND BTS.ISLATEST = 1
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
SDIAccountId
,CustomerAccountId
,LastSixDigitsRelatedCustomerAccountId
,DirectIndicator
,RoleId
,ProcessingOrgId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,PayReceiveId
,MethodId
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, SDIAccountId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
SDIAccountId
,CustomerAccountId
,LastSixDigitsRelatedCustomerAccountId
,DirectIndicator
,RoleId
,ProcessingOrgId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,PayReceiveId
,MethodId
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, SDIAccountId
FROM BNKM.SDIAccount --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'TRY'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.SDIAccountId,TGT.SDIAccountId) AS SDIAccountId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.SDIAccountId = TGT.SDIAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	SDIAccountId = SRC.SDIAccountId
	,CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
	,LastSixDigitsRelatedCustomerAccountId = SRC.LastSixDigitsRelatedCustomerAccountId
	,DirectIndicator = SRC.DirectIndicator
	,RoleId = SRC.RoleId
	,ProcessingOrgId = SRC.ProcessingOrgId
	,IsoCurrencyCode = SRC.IsoCurrencyCode
	,PayReceiveId = SRC.PayReceiveId
	,MethodId = SRC.MethodId
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'
	,WorkFlowId = 0
	,TaskRunId = 0
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.SDIAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.SDIAccountId = TGT.SDIAccountId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount SRC ON SRC.SDIAccountId = TGT.SDIAccountId ;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.SDIAccount
(
	SDIAccountId
	,CustomerAccountId
	,LastSixDigitsRelatedCustomerAccountId
	,DirectIndicator
	,RoleId
	,ProcessingOrgId
	,IsoCurrencyCode
	,PayReceiveId
	,MethodId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
	SDIAccountId
	,CustomerAccountId
	,LastSixDigitsRelatedCustomerAccountId
	,DirectIndicator
	,RoleId
	,ProcessingOrgId
	,IsoCurrencyCode
	,PayReceiveId
	,MethodId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_SDIAccount_DELTA;

END
